# Continuous Integration - GitHub - PHP

![GitHub Verified Creator](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Verified%20Creator-4493F8?logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)
[![Continuous Integration](https://github.com/hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-php/actions/workflows/__main-ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-php/actions/workflows/__main-ci.yml)
[![GitHub tag](https://img.shields.io/github/tag/hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-php?include_prereleases=&sort=semver&color=blue)](https://github.com/hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-php/releases/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue)](#license)
[![PRs Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md)

Reusable GitHub Actions and workflows for PHP applications and Composer libraries.
Install dependencies, lint, test, generate API documentation, and publish
GitHub releases with Conventional Commit version planning.

## Prerequisites

Use GitHub.com and Linux runners. Self-hosted runners require GitHub Actions
runner 2.336.0 or newer for native `$/` action references. GitHub Enterprise Server
is not supported. Documentation builds require Docker on the runner.

Define project commands in Composer scripts. Start with the
[CI guide](github/workflows/continuous-integration.md) for the default conventions and
optional configuration.

## Actions

### Continuous integration

- [Lint](actions/lint/index.md): run Composer lint scripts and report issues.
- [Test](actions/test/index.md): run tests, reports and coverage.
- [Test a Composer distribution](actions/package/test/index.md): check the committed source as an installed dependency.

### Environment setup

- [Setup PHP](actions/setup-php/index.md): install PHP and Composer dependencies.

## Reusable workflows and guides

- [Continuous integration](github/workflows/continuous-integration.md): reusable CI inputs and outputs.
- [Documentation](github/workflows/documentation.md): generate PHP API documentation for separate deployment.
- [Prepare package release](github/workflows/prepare-package-release.md): plan a version before validation.
- [Release](github/workflows/release.md): manual and scheduled Composer releases, configuration and recovery.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-php/blob/main/docs/README.md): usage and development guides.
